I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-random. I noted the 26 August deadline for the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines and told her nothing needs doing yet, as she said.

The simulation clock says today is 14 October 2026, so 26 August this year has already passed. I asked her whether she meant 26 August 2027 or a different date. I took no other action.
